posts.title: Announcing tylertoo (GeoParquet --> PMTiles goes brrr)
posts.description: Just before the CNG Forum , I cut a v0.8 release of tylertoo : a GeoParquet to PMTiles generator in Rust. It’s fast (7-10x faster than tippecanoe ), supports cool stuff like remote reads, streaming, bounded memory, and sharded jobs on multiple machines, has pretty much all the other functionality of tippecanoe , and, oh yeah, it’s really fast . Check it out! Wait, why not just use tippecanoe ? Bec
